title: Head of Production
description:
**Company Description**
Jiteen Automobiles Pvt Ltd is an automotive manufacturing company with a focus on reliable, high-quality production and efficient operations. The organization emphasizes streamlined processes, safety, and continuous improvement across all manufacturing activities. Team members collaborate closely to meet customer expectations, maintain strict quality standards, and optimize resource utilization. The company values accountability, professionalism, and long-term growth for both the business and its workforce.
  
**Role Description**
The Head of Production will oversee all production activities to ensure that output meets quality, cost, and delivery targets. This full-time, on-site role is based in Chakan and involves planning and monitoring daily production schedules, coordinating with procurement, quality, and maintenance teams, and resolving operational issues. The role includes managing and mentoring production supervisors and line staff, implementing process improvements, and enforcing safety and compliance standards. The Head of Production will track performance metrics, optimize resource allocation, manage production budgets, and support strategic initiatives related to capacity, efficiency, and cost reduction.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Production Planning and Production Management to oversee schedules, workflows, and output quality.
* Candidates should possess solid Operations Management and Budgeting skills to control costs, manage resources, and support profitability.
* Candidates should possess effective Team Management skills to lead, motivate, and develop production staff at multiple levels.
* Experience in automotive or manufacturing environments, with familiarity in lean manufacturing, process optimization, and safety standards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with proficiency in production planning tools and ERP systems.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, with a track record of handling high-volume operations.

title: Senior Health & Safety Engineer
description:
Vacancy Introduction
  
  
Haskoning is an independent consulting engineering company that is dedicated to creating a positive impact on people and planet. Backed by the expertise of over 6,000 colleagues working from offices in more than 20 countries, and with more than 140 years of experience under our belt, we are helping clients with challenges ranging from climate change and digital transformation to changing customer demands and the energy transition. Driven by our mission Enhancing Society Together, we believe that each and every one of us holds the power to deliver measurable positive impact on society through our projects, and in our own operations
  
  
What will you do
  
  

* Review and recommend approval of the EPC Contractor's HSE plans, risk assessments, method statements, emergency response plans, and safety procedures.
* Monitor compliance with contractual HSE requirements, statutory regulations, labour laws, permit conditions, ISO 45001, and applicable safety standards.
* Conduct regular safety inspections, audits, and site surveillance to identify hazards and ensure effective implementation of safety controls.
* Review and verify implementation of HIRA, JSA, PTW systems, and other risk management processes.
* Monitor safety performance during high-risk construction activities such as excavation, working at height, lifting operations, confined space entry, electrical works, hot works, testing, and commissioning.
* Review incidents, near misses, non-conformities, and CAPA reports, ensuring timely closure of corrective actions.
* Participate in incident investigations and verify implementation of preventive measures.
* Monitor the competency and effectiveness of Contractor HSE personnel, training programs, toolbox talks, and safety awareness initiatives.
* Track HSE performance indicators, audit findings, and compliance trends, and prepare periodic HSE reports for the Client and PMC.
* Participate in HSE coordination meetings and provide recommendations to improve safety performance and safety culture.
* Monitor emergency preparedness, evacuation arrangements, safety equipment, and emergency response drills.
* Advise the Client on significant safety risks and recommend corrective actions, including suspension of unsafe activities when required.

Where you will work
  
  
Roha, Raigad
  
  
What you bring
  
  
Education & Certifications
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Environmental, Industrial Safety, or equivalent).
* Degree/Diploma in Industrial Safety, Occupational Health & Safety, or a related discipline.
* NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent HSE certification preferred.
* ISO 45001 Lead Auditor/Internal Auditor certification desirable.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 15 years of HSE experience in infrastructure, utility, industrial, or EPC projects.
* Experience in roads, water supply, sewerage, drainage, utility, industrial, or building construction projects.
* Strong expertise in HSE audits, risk assessments (HIRA/JSA), incident investigations, contractor safety management, and CAPA systems.
* Sound knowledge of ISO 45001, Indian statutory safety regulations, and World Bank/IFC EHS Guidelines.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and report-writing skills in English and Hindi.

What we offer you
  
  

* Market competitive salary
* Experience in an employee friendly work culture
* Insurance cover for self and family
* Social Security
* Paid leaves
* Group Profit Sharing

Are you our new colleague?
  
  
We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. The application process then consists of 1-2 interviews and a possibly assessment. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
  
  
For more information, you can always contact Pranita Gupte, at pranita.gupte@haskoning.com.
  
  
Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email. Do you know someone who might be interested? Share this vacancy

title: Continuous Improvement Engineer
description:
Syensqo is all about chemistry. We’re not just referring to chemical reactions here, but also to the magic that occurs when the brightest minds get to work together. This is where our true strength lies. In you. In your future colleagues and in all your differences. And of course, in your ideas to improve lives while preserving our planet’s beauty for the generations to come.
  
**We are looking for:**

* A skilled Continual Improvement Engineer to drive process optimization and operational excellence across the organization and utilize methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and other quality management tools to identify opportunities, implement improvements, and sustain best practices, supporting Syensqo mission of scientific exploration and breakthrough advancement.

**We count on you for:**

* Process Analysis & Optimization: Analyze current processes, identify inefficiencies, and recommend improvements to enhance productivity, quality, and safety.
* Project Management: Lead and support improvement projects from conception through implementation, ensuring timely delivery and measurable results.
* Data Collection & Analysis:Gather and analyze data to identify trends, root causes, and areas for improvement using statistical tools.
* Training & Coaching: Train and mentor employees on continuous improvement methodologies and best practices.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with production, quality, engineering, and other teams to ensure alignment and successful implementation of improvement initiatives.
* Performance Monitoring: Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of improvement activities.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate records of process changes, project progress, and outcomes.

**You can count on us for:**

* The chance to build a strong network across functions and manufacturing locations.
* Significant investment in your professional development to prepare you for future roles within the organization.
* An inclusive workplace culture that values and respects individual differences and backgrounds.

**You will bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or related field (Master’s preferred)
* 3-7 years’ experience in process improvement, manufacturing, or quality engineering
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies (certification is a plus)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Project management experience is an advantage
* Proficiency in data analysis tools (Minitab, Power BI)
* Results-oriented mindset
* Initiative and proactivity
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Adaptability and openness to change
* Attention to detai

**You will get:**

* Competitive salary package.
* 16 weeks of maternity, paternity, or co-parenting leave.
* Access to a comprehensive training platform.
* Complimentary well-being sessions (physical and psychological).

**Additional Information:**

* Location: Roha, Maharashtra

**About Us**

* Syensqo is a science company developing groundbreaking solutions that enhance the way we live, work, travel and play. Inspired by the scientific councils which Ernest Solvay initiated in 1911, we bring great minds together to push the limits of science and innovation for the benefit of our customers, with a diverse, global team of more than 13,000 associates. Our solutions contribute to safer, cleaner, and more sustainable products found in homes, food and consumer goods, planes, cars, batteries, smart devices and health care applications. Our innovation power enables us to deliver on the ambition of a circular economy and explore breakthrough technologies that advance humanity.
* At Syensqo, we seek to promote unity and not uniformity. We value the diversity that individuals bring and we invite you to consider a future with us, regardless of background, age, gender, national origin, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, ability or identity. We encourage individuals who may require any assistance or accommodations to let us know to ensure a seamless application experience. We are here to support you throughout the application journey and want to ensure all candidates are treated equally. If you are unsure whether you meet all the criteria or qualifications listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

title: New Product Development Manager
description:
**Job Description: Head – New Product Development (NPD)**
**Position Overview**

The Head of New Product Development (NPD) will lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle—from concept to commercialization—ensuring alignment with customer requirements, cost targets, and manufacturing capabilities. The role demands strong technical expertise in forging and machining processes along with strategic leadership to drive innovation and business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Product Development & Execution**

* Lead complete NPD lifecycle: RFQ analysis → feasibility → design → prototyping → validation → PPAP → SOP.
* Drive development of components related to:
* Forged parts
* Precision machined components
* Gear systems (gear cutting & finishing)
* Welded assemblies
* Ensure adherence to customer timelines and APQP milestones.

**2. Technical Feasibility & Engineering**

* Conduct feasibility studies considering:
* Forging design & die development
* Machining cycle time & process optimization
* Gear cutting parameters (hobbing, shaping, grinding)
* Welding processes (MIG/TIG/Spot)
* Collaborate with design and production teams for manufacturability (DFM/DFA).
* Optimize product design for cost, quality, and performance.

**3. Customer Interaction & Business Development**

* Interface with OEM customers for new enquiries and technical discussions.
* Support costing and RFQ submissions with technical inputs.
* Participate in design reviews and customer audits.

**4. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with:
* Production
* Quality
* Tool Room
* Purchase & Supply Chain
* Ensure smooth transition from development to mass production.

**5. Process Development & Validation**

* Establish robust manufacturing processes.
* Lead trials, pilot runs, and validation builds.
* Ensure documentation:
* Control Plans
* PFMEA
* Process Flow Diagrams
* Work Instructions

**6. Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with automotive standards (IATF 16949).
* Drive PPAP submissions and approvals.
* Implement root cause analysis and corrective actions.

**7. Costing & Value Engineering**

* Identify cost reduction opportunities through:
* Design optimization
* Alternate materials/processes
* Cycle time reduction
* Support localization and vendor development.

**8. Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor NPD, design, and process engineering teams.
* Build a high-performance, innovation-driven culture.

**Technical Skill Requirements**
**Core Manufacturing Expertise**

* Forging processes (closed die, hot forging, die design basics)
* CNC machining (turning, milling, VMC/HMC operations)
* Gear manufacturing (hobbing, shaping, shaving, grinding)
* Grinding processes (Cylindrical, Surface, Gear grinding)
* Welding techniques (MIG, TIG, robotic welding preferred)

**Engineering & Design**

* Strong understanding of GD&T and tolerance stack-up
* Hands-on experience with CAD tools (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Creo)
* Knowledge of simulation tools (preferred)

**Quality & Systems**

* APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA
* Root cause analysis tools (8D, Why-Why, Fishbone)

**Costing & Process Optimization**

* Knowledge of cost estimation for forged & machined parts
* Lean manufacturing & Six Sigma principles

**Educational Qualification**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (Mandatory)
* M.Tech or MBA (Operations/Strategy) – Preferred

**Experience**

* 12–18 years in automotive/component manufacturing
* Minimum 5+ years in leadership role in NPD or Engineering
* Experience with OEM customers (e.g., automotive, tractor, off-highway)

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking with strong execution focus
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Strong customer handling and negotiation skills
* Leadership and team-building capability
* High ownership and accountability

**KPIs / Success Metrics**

* On-time NPD project completion (% adherence to timeline)
* PPAP approval success rate
* Cost reduction / value engineering savings
* First-time-right development (minimal rework)
* Customer satisfaction score
* New business revenue contribution

**Reporting Structure**

* Reports to: Plant Head Operations
* Direct Reports: NPD Engineers

title: SAP Lead
description:

**AGM/Senior Manager - SAP MM & SD**
to spearhead end-to-end SAP implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support initiatives across multiple business verticals. The ideal candidate will possess deep functional expertise in
**SAP(MM)**
and
**(SD)**
, along with proven project management capabilities to lead complex SAP transformation programs.

This role requires strong leadership in driving business process optimization, system integration, governance, and digital transformation initiatives, preferably within the
**Real Estate, Construction, or Infrastructure**
sectors. The incumbent will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, and external partners to deliver scalable SAP solutions aligned with organizational objectives.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage SAP implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support projects across business units.
* Lead SAP functional and technical teams to design and deliver business solutions.

* Strong expertise in SAP modules such as FICO, MM, SD, PP, and related business processes.

* Proven stakeholder management and cross-functional team leadership skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and leadership abilities.
* Sound understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), including Segregation of Duties (SoD), User Access Governance, Change & Release Management, Incident Management, Compliance Monitoring, and Audit Readiness.
* Experience in SAP governance, risk management, compliance (GRC), and regulatory frameworks such as SOX.
* Ability to drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and digital transformation projects.

**Experience:**

* 8-15 years of overall SAP experience
* Minimum 3+ years of Project Management experience
* Experience in SAP implementation, rollouts, upgrades, and support projects
* Prior experience in Real Estate business processes preferred

**Education:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) preferred
* MBA (IT / Operations) will be an added advantage
* Any graduate with relevant SAP experience may also be considered

**Certifications:**

* SAP Certification in MM, SD, or related modules preferred
* Experience with
  **SAP S/4HANA implementations, migrations, or support projects**
  will be an added advantage

title: Programme Coordinator True School of Music (TSM)
description:
**Company Description:**
Vijaybhoomi University (VU), located in Karjat, Raigad, is India’s first Liberal Professional University, offering programmes in engineering, business, law, science, and liberal arts. The university focuses on providing relevant, high-quality education and fostering an environment that encourages impactful research. VU is committed to nurturing holistic, socially responsible professionals who remain continuously employable in a dynamic world. Rather than only preparing individuals to be "industry-ready", the university emphasises personality development and resilience to help learners face and transcend challenges in diverse fields. Applicants joining VU can expect a mission-driven academic environment that values innovation, ethics, and personal growth.

**Role Description:**
The True School of Music (TSM) Programme Coordinator is a full-time, on-site role based at the University, responsible for supporting the planning, execution, and monitoring of academic and co-curricular programmes. The role involves coordinating schedules, events, and activities across departments, maintaining programme documentation, and ensuring timely communication with faculty, staff, students, and external stakeholders. The Programme Coordinator will assist in programme development, track progress against milestones, and prepare reports and presentations for leadership. Daily tasks include responding to enquiries, offering courteous and efficient service to students and partners, organising meetings and workshops, and addressing operational issues to keep programmes running smoothly. The role also requires collaboration with administrative teams to improve processes, support admissions or outreach activities when needed, and uphold the university’s standards for quality and learner experience.

**Qualifications**

* Programme management and programme development skills to plan, implement, and enhance academic and co-curricular initiatives.
* Project management abilities to manage timelines, resources, and deliverables across multiple concurrent activities.
* Strong communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication and effective coordination with diverse stakeholders.
* Customer service orientation to provide responsive, respectful, and solution-focused support to students, faculty, and partners.
* Proficiency with office productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, and presentation software) and basic data tracking.
* Demonstrated organisational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently as well as collaboratively.
* Experience in academic administration, programme coordination, or higher education settings is preferred.

title: Production Engineer - Heavy Engineering Fabrication
description:
**About Zeeco**
Zeeco is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced combustion and environmental solutions serving the refining, petrochemical, oil & gas, power, chemical, and pharmaceutical industries. Headquartered in the United States, Zeeco designs and manufactures world-class burners, flares, thermal oxidizers, vapor recovery systems, and fired equipment that help customers improve process efficiency while reducing emissions.
  
  
With manufacturing and engineering facilities across the globe, Zeeco combines innovative technology, engineering excellence, and superior manufacturing capabilities to deliver customized solutions that meet the highest international quality standards.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Zeeco India is seeking an experienced
**Production Engineer**
to lead and coordinate the fabrication and manufacturing of heavy process equipment including
**pressure vessels, process skids, columns, ducting, stacks, structural assemblies, and other static equipment**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess
**8 to 12 years of hands-on shop floor experience**
in heavy engineering fabrication and should have a strong understanding of fabrication methodologies, welding processes, production planning, resource optimization, quality requirements, and statutory fabrication codes. The individual will be responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and timely execution of manufacturing activities while maintaining the highest standards of quality and productivity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Production Planning & Manufacturing Execution:****

* Plan, schedule, and monitor fabrication activities to achieve project delivery milestones.
* Prepare daily and weekly production plans based on project priorities and manufacturing capacity.
* Coordinate fabrication activities involving pressure vessels, process skids, structural assemblies, ducting, stacks, and other static equipment.
* Review engineering drawings, fabrication drawings, General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Bill of Materials (BOM), welding maps, and manufacturing specifications before production.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, consumables, and shop floor resources.
* Monitor production progress and proactively resolve manufacturing bottlenecks to achieve committed delivery schedules.
* Coordinate closely with Engineering, Planning, Procurement, QA/QC, and Project Management teams throughout the manufacturing cycle.

****Heavy Fabrication & Shop Floor Management:****
  
  

* Supervise fabrication activities including:

+ Plate cutting
+ Rolling
+ Forming
+ Fit-up
+ Welding
+ Assembly
+ Structural fabrication
+ Equipment integration
+ Final assembly

* Ensure fabrication activities comply with approved fabrication procedures and project requirements.
* Monitor welding activities and ensure compliance with approved WPS, PQR, and welder qualifications.
* Oversee fabrication of Carbon Steel, Stainless Steel, Duplex Stainless Steel, Alloy Steel, and other process equipment materials.
* Ensure dimensional accuracy through regular inspections during fabrication and assembly.
* Coordinate lifting, handling, and movement of heavy fabricated components within the workshop.

****Quality, Codes & Compliance:****
  
  

* Ensure manufacturing activities comply with applicable international standards including:

+ ASME Section VIII Div.1
+ ASME Section IX
+ API Standards
+ ISO Standards
+ Customer Specifications

* Coordinate with QA/QC during:

+ Fit-up inspections
+ Welding inspections
+ Visual inspection
+ NDT activities
+ Hydrostatic testing
+ Pneumatic testing
+ Dimensional inspection
+ Final release inspections

* Maintain complete fabrication documentation, weld traceability, material traceability, and production records.
* Support customer inspections, third-party inspections, and statutory audits.

****People Management & Shop Floor Leadership:****

* Lead welders, fitters, fabricators, riggers, and technicians.
* Allocate work based on manpower capability and production priorities.
* Monitor productivity and implement corrective actions where required.
* Mentor junior engineers and supervisors on fabrication best practices.
* Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, quality, and operational excellence.

****Safety & Continuous Improvement:****

* Ensure strict adherence to company HSE policies and safe fabrication practices.
* Conduct regular shop floor inspections to eliminate unsafe conditions.
* Identify opportunities for improving productivity, reducing fabrication cycle time, and minimizing rework.
* Support implementation of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) for quality issues and implement preventive actions.

**Mandatory Experience**
Candidates
**must have hands-on experience**
in the fabrication and manufacturing of one or more of the following:
  
  

* Pressure Vessels
* Process Skids
* Heat Exchangers
* Columns
* Reactors
* Storage Tanks
* Static Equipment
* Fired Heaters
* Thermal Oxidizers
* Process Equipment
* Heavy Structural Fabrication

**Experience From Industries Such As**

* Oil & Gas
* Petrochemical
* EPC
* Heavy Engineering
* Process Equipment Manufacturing
* Boiler Manufacturing
* Pressure Vessel Manufacturing
* Industrial Equipment Manufacturing

will be highly preferred.

title: Construction Site Manager
description:
We are building two villa projects in Karjat - Trulife at Tadwadi and Goodlife at Kothimbe. We are looking for one person to run both sites: living at site, with real authority over execution, reporting directly to the founder.

**The work**

* Run day-to-day construction at both sites - manpower, material, sequence, quality, closure.
* Lead 10 to 15 engineers and supervisors, and 100 to 150+ workers across multiple contractors.
* Plan the week before it starts. Schedule, material indents, manpower, contractor commitments - fixed in advance, not decided on the morning.
* Send daily and weekly MIS to our head office in Vashi: progress against plan, manpower on site, material position, what is blocked.
* Hold quality. Check the work, and make it redone when it is not right.
* Meet customers who come to site. Villa buyers want to speak to someone senior and want a straight answer on their handover date. You will be that person.
* Keep contractors moving. Settle problems at site rather than escalating all of them.

**What we are looking for**

* 12 to 18 years on construction sites, with at least the last 5 running a project independently.
* Proven team size: 10+ engineers and supervisors, 100+ workers on site at peak.
* Experience at sites in Maharashtra.
* Diploma or degree in civil engineering.
* Fluent Hindi and Marathi. Able to hold a proper conversation with a customer in English.
* Someone who plans ahead rather than firefights, and who gets work finished on a date.

**What we provide**

* Stay and food at site.
* Rs 70,000 to Rs 1,20,000 per month, depending on what you have actually run.
* A direct line to the founder, and the authority to run the site your way.

**Being straight with you**

This is six days a week, long days, and you will live at site through the week, away from home. The sites are in Karjat, not in a city. If that does not suit you, this is not your job. If you have done it before and you enjoy running a site properly - planned, clean, on date - you will like it here.

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn. If we shortlist you, we will send you a short set of questions to answer in writing, then an online interview, then a visit to the site to meet us and walk the project.

description:

The role requires strong techno-commercial expertise in procurement, contract management, vendor development, and commercial negotiations. The successful candidate will be responsible for sourcing qualified service providers, administering contracts, ensuring timely execution of services, and supporting cost-effective project delivery while maintaining compliance with company standards and contractual obligations.

+ Financial stability
+ Quality systems

* Lead commercial negotiations with vendors covering:

+ Pricing
+ Payment terms
+ Delivery schedules
+ Liquidated Damages (LD) clauses
+ Warranty obligations
+ Taxes and duties
+ Commercial risks
+ Contractual obligations

* Finalize contract terms in alignment with company objectives, project schedules, and risk mitigation requirements.
* Prepare and issue Purchase Orders (POs), Service Orders, and Work Orders after obtaining all required internal approvals.
* Ensure contractual documentation is complete, accurate, and aligned with organizational procurement standards.

**Order Execution, Expediting & Contract Administration**

* Monitor vendor progress to ensure timely execution of contracted services in accordance with project schedules.
* Coordinate with QA/QC, Projects, Planning, Manufacturing, Stores, and Engineering teams to resolve execution-related issues.
* Track service completion milestones and ensure compliance with contractual deliverables.
* Manage contract variations, deviations, change orders, claims, and commercial correspondence throughout project execution.
* Support timely resolution of contractual disputes while protecting company interests.

**Documentation, Compliance & Cost Control**

* Maintain complete procurement documentation, contract records, commercial correspondence, and historical cost databases.
* Develop and maintain vendor performance records for future procurement decisions.
* Maintain cost benchmarking data to support strategic sourcing initiatives and commercial negotiations.
* Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, contractual obligations, statutory regulations, and audit requirements.
* Support internal and external audits by providing complete procurement and contract documentation.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience in techno-commercial evaluation, cost analysis, and commercial benchmarking.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritize multiple procurement activities and work effectively under project-driven schedules.
* Proficiency in ERP systems and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, for procurement reporting and commercial analysis.

title: Assistant Manager – Exim and Transport Management
description:
**Job Posting Title**
 Assistant Manager – Exim and Transport Management
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
* Oversee end\-to\-end import/export processes, including booking containers, tracking shipments, and optimizing transportation routes to reduce costs.
* Prepare, verify, and process documentation, including Bills of Entry, Packing Lists, Invoices, and Certificates of Origin. Ensure strict compliance with DGFT, customs, and FEMA regulations.
* Liaise with Custom House Agents (CHA) and authorities to resolve clearance issues and expedite cargo movement.
* Negotiate freight rates, contracts, and service level agreements (SLAs) with shipping lines, airlines, and logistics providers.
* Maintain accurate records of transactions, analyze inventory levels, and prepare reports on logistics performance.
* Manage all processes and functions within logistics department right from ordering to dispatch and invoicing
* Managing entire order processing activities including planning, requirement analysis \& resource management to execute order to meet the committed delivery schedule
* Lead the logistics cost optimization initiatives and continuous improvement project.
* Handled the DGFT license, incentive schemes, customs compliance and international Logistic activity.
* Interface with Regional and Global Logistics team and business divisions to ensure the alignment with organization objective.

**About Dauch**
 Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain\-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries \- GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward.
